html:
SMTO-MEM-0011 — The agent must read a memory fully before judging it

GUID: ac14ec29-41e3-5668-b053-a187c2328194
Slug: memory-inspection-required
Domain: MEM · Subsystem: memory

What happened

  • The agent tried to record whether a saved memory applies to your task before reading all of it, so SMTO didn't record that judgment. Nothing else changed, and the agent is told what to read next.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Let the task keep running. The agent gets the next part of the memory to read, then records its judgment again. SMTO accepts the judgment only after the whole current memory has been read.
  2. If this keeps repeating, open Settings › Operate › Agent Checks and see whether Memory inspection before work is on; turn it off if you don't need it. This check is off by default, and when it's off the task continues without these memory judgments.
  3. Don't ask the agent to repeat commands or changes it already finished. Repeating finished work could apply it twice and won't fix the missing memory read.

What success looks like

  • The task moves past the memory check, and its activity shows the memory was read and assessed.

If it still fails

  • If the agent has clearly read the whole memory and this still repeats, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO; it may be a tracking problem. Asking the agent to reword its judgment won't help.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • memory.assess rejected the batch (MemoryInspectionRequired) because a referenced memory revision is absent, inactive, stale, or not fully retrieved and delivered; no assessment was recorded.

What this means

  • The assessment arguments were accepted, but the task has no complete delivery record for the selected current memory revision. This can mean an unread or shortened result, a changed revision, or a delivery-tracking problem. No assessment was recorded.

Why this can happen

  • The current memory was not retrieved, was only partially delivered, or changed revision.
  • The result delivery tracker did not recognize the model-visible representation.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the memory key, current revision and retrieved/delivered flags, then compare the result actually sent to the model.

How to fix it

  • Follow next_action exactly, including its offset: call memory.get for a missing or stale revision, or read_result for each continuation page until complete=true, then retry the unchanged assessment once. Rewording valid decisions cannot replace missing reads; if the whole current revision is already visible, investigate delivery tracking in src/agent_runtime/skills/memory/inspection_delivery.py.
  • Follow next_action exactly, including its offset. Read every continuation page until complete=true, then retry the unchanged assessment once. Rewording valid decisions cannot replace missing reads.

Retry and execution caution

  • The complete current memory revision has been read and recorded as delivered.

How to verify the fix

  • The current memory revision is fully delivered and its assessment succeeds.

What not to do

  • Do not reword valid arguments to repair missing delivery.
  • Do not repeat successful external actions to repair memory bookkeeping.

Technical notes

  • This is a memory-read prerequisite, not an assessment JSON format error. Memory application never blocks task completion.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-MEM-0006 — This memory changed before your change was saved
  • SMTO-API-0001 — A step was rejected because its details were in the wrong form
